title: A Circle Stroke-Driven Method for Graph Construction of Oracle Bone Characters
description: Reference implementation, datasets, figures and tables for the paper "A Circle Stroke-Driven Method for Graph Construction of Oracle Bone Characters". The repository contains the proposed skeleton-to-graph pipeline (method A), re-implementations of five baselines (methods B-F), the ablation and parameter-sensitivity scripts, the input skeleton images, the ground-truth adjacency matrices and the resulting figures and tables. All scripts resolve paths relative to the repository root, so no absolute paths need to be configured. The source code is released under the MIT License. The character images, skeleton images and ground-truth graphs under data/ are redistributed from the Graph-Based Evolutionary Dataset for Oracle Bone Characters and remain subject to the terms of that dataset; if you use the data, please also cite Wang, M. et al., Study on the evolution of Chinese characters based on few-shot learning: From oracle bone inscriptions to regular script, PLoS ONE 17, e0272974 (2022).
